description: With a configured path and domain matching the request, an incoming cookie within that scope is loaded, updated and re-emitted with the configured path and domain.

cases.expected_output:
status=200
loaded.new=false
loaded.empty=false
loaded.contents={"a": 1, "b": 2}
set_cookie=present
cookie.cleared=false
cookie.httponly=true
cookie.path=/anotherpath
cookie.domain=127.0.0.1
cookie.max_age=10
cookie.expires=Sun, 09-Sep-2001 01:46:50 GMT
payload.created=1000000000
payload.session={"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3}
